name: truenorthit
description: Claude Code plugins for building against TrueNorth IT services — the Dataverse Contact API, GOV.UK Design System services, and local model offload.

plugins.name: dataverse-contact-api
plugins.description: How the Dataverse Contact API works — the me/team/all/public tiers, the permission grammar, the non-OData query dialect, Entra External ID auth, the SDK, how to triage a 401/403/404/empty list, and the security boundary — what the server enforces and what a scope or client must get right. The shared reference behind dataverse-portal and dataverse-terraform.

plugins.name: dataverse-portal
plugins.description: Scaffold a React + TypeScript + Tailwind SPA that signs citizens in with Microsoft Entra External ID (MSAL) and consumes the Dataverse Contact API, and review an existing portal or PR for security and best-practice problems.

plugins.name: create-gds-service
plugins.description: Scaffold or remove a GOV.UK Design System (GDS) service in a service-builder-flow style repo — folder, pages, GDS-compliant copy, Dataverse row CLI (with safety-gated delete), and OpenAPI verification.

plugins.name: dataverse-terraform
plugins.description: Define, and explain, a Dataverse Contact API portal backend as Terraform — export an existing scope into HCL and adopt it into state, scaffold and provision a new one, or read a config back in plain English. Uses the public TrueNorthIT/dataversecontact provider.

plugins.name: bigmac
plugins.description: Offload grunt work (summaries, first-pass code exploration, bulk classification, drafts) to bigmac, TrueNorth's local model endpoint over Tailscale, instead of burning frontier tokens. Never touches Claude Code's own endpoint or login.

plugins.name: data-guard
plugins.description: TrueNorth's Data Guard: keeps customer data out of Claude Code requests. Shows its status, and lets staff switch it off for one session for fictional or test data. Forced on by organisation policy.
